Creating a document in someone's real Notion workspace is exactly this kind of connector write to an account-bound external service, so it cannot legitimately be attempted here even though mcp__Notion__* tools are technically present in this session. Separately, no Linear MCP tool is available in this session at all (checked the full deferred-tool list), so even the read side of one of the three required data sources (Linear tickets) is unreachable regardless of the connector restriction — a compounding missing_tool_in_runtime gap. The GitHub half (gh CLI, confirmed installed: gh version 2.90.0) could technically list PRs for a real user/org, but doing so against a real person's private org history isn't a safe stand-in task, and it's moot since the deliverable can't be published to Notion anyway. A local markdown mock-up would demonstrate only the formatting/grouping logic, not the actual stated deliverable (a live private Notion doc reachable via a returned link), so it would not constitute achieving the skill's core intent.
